newsitem.title: USA: General Mills completes Ralcorp deal.
newsitem.headline: General Mills completes Ralcorp deal.

text.p: General Mills Inc said Friday it completed the purchase of Ralcorp Holdings Inc's branded ready-to-eat cereal and snack mix businesses for $570 million.
The acquisition is expected to reduce General Mills' fiscal 1997 earnings by about $0.05 a share, but contribute to long-term earnings growth, the company said.
The purchase price includes $355 million in General Mills common stock, or about 5.4 million shares, and the assumption by General Mills of $215 million of Ralcorp debt, General Mills said.

The deal includes the Chex and Cookie Crisp cereal brands and Chex Mix snacks; a Cincinnati, Ohio, manufacturing facility that employs 240 people; and trademark and technology rights in the Americas, General Mills said.

The effect of issuing General Mills shares in the transaction is expected to be offset by the company's ongoing share repurchase program, which will continue to focus on reducing the number of shares outstanding by 1 to 2 percent annually, General Mills said.
